$comment: Webfonts vendored into public/fonts/. Run `npm run fonts:fetch` to sync.
Separate from themes.manifest.json because a font is not a theme: it is vendored once
and any number of themes may reference it. Community themes still bring their own fonts
along inside their pack, exactly as upstream shipped them — this file is only for fonts
our own built-in themes ask for.
Each family is published on npm as a set of stylesheets that split one font across many
`unicode-range` subsets. That splitting is the entire reason a CJK face is affordable
here: the whole family is megabytes, but a browser only downloads the subsets whose
ranges the document actually uses, so an English page pays for a couple of them.
'sheets' names the stylesheets to take — one per weight. Their @font-face rules are
concatenated into <slug>.css and every woff2 they reference is vendored alongside, so
the result is self-contained and the site still works offline and from disk.
Only fonts whose licence permits redistribution belong here. See THIRD-PARTY.md.
